# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received and printed in both languages. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Translation is free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO SWAP[/bold], South Dormitories, mine side, next to the geothermal storage. Warmest rack in the block. Wants a bed in the research housing, will throw in a good parka. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], quiet room for a night shift lab tech. No card games after midnight, no radio, no harmonica. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Colony housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]TUNNEL HANDS WANTED[/bold] for planting crews in the warm levels. Mud, heat and long walks back up. Botany pays the overtime. - [bold]TRANSLATOR[/bold], Russian and English, offers help with contracts, pay slips and checkpoint forms. Paid in tea, cigarettes or credits.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]HEATED BOOT LINERS[/bold], two pairs, batteries hold a full shift on the decks. Thirty credits or a bottle of something clear. - [bold]FISHING TACKLE[/bold] for Carp Lake, hand tied. Seller is going home on the next shuttle and the fish can stay.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: Sestra pass card in a blue sleeve, somewhere between the canteen and the aerodrome checkpoint. Please return it before the guards find it first. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: mittens, one pair, on the basketball court. Collect them at the bar by naming the colour.
## Notices - The Friday match on the basketball court is mine levels against the labs, as always. Loser buys at the bar, as always. - Medical reminds everyone that the hot springs are hotter than they look.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
